paper.title: EASI-PASS: An accessible pipeline for linking functional imaging and mRNA profiling
public_claims: molecular identity recovery around 78% after matching functional imaging to EASI-FISH
PBN: fine-scale molecular specificity among neurons receiving long-range spinal input
awake V1: distinct arousal modulation and spatial falloff in correlations within and across interneuron classes
paper.scope_note: The public EASI-PASS repository is an alignment/matching pipeline; the PBN/V1 biological analyses require downstream same-cell functional+molecular data.

method_reproduction.blocker: official Python 3.12 environment cannot currently resolve pinned build dependency through PyPI on this workstation

PBN.scientific_question: Does response to long-range spinal input select molecularly distinct PBN neurons beyond coarse identity/anatomical position?

same_cell_table: one explicitly defined spinal-input optogenetic response endpoint
recommended: response significance/quality flag if defined outcome-blind

semantic_binding_required.response_column: must be explicitly bound by the analyst; GAP must not guess which generic numeric column means spinal-input response
semantic_binding_required.molecular_identity: measured EASI-FISH genes or predeclared molecular class
semantic_binding_required.positive_response_definition: must follow the paper/experiment's prespecified response criterion if supplied; otherwise analyze continuous response without inventing a responder threshold

GAP_execution: Fig1 coordinate mediation: genes vs molecular class vs space on identical held-animal splits
Zhao-style relation-index only when a discrete molecular class and >=2 response dimensions exist within the same domain; a single spinal-response endpoint uses function-map/AIC/effect-size instead
same-sample delta-AIC for continuous genes versus categorical identity
within-animal rank-biserial/effect-size for continuous molecular coordinates
Fig2 exact PBN AtlasLift using mouse_pbn_paulichen_exact
Fig3 fixed-budget panel selection only if the measured panel contains enough genes and >=2 biological units

paper_native_replication_tests.name: molecular_specificity_of_spinal_response
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: held-animal association between spinal-response magnitude/state and molecular identity
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: do not pool cells as independent biological replicates; do not force Zhao-style relation-index for a one-dimensional response

paper_native_replication_tests.name: identity_vs_space
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: test whether molecular coordinates add response information beyond anatomical position
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: space and molecular identity use identical outer splits

paper_native_replication_tests.name: reference_state_mapping
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: map measured PBN panel to exact PBN published molecular states
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: reference headroom is not response-biology evidence

V1.scientific_question: How do interneuron molecular classes differ in arousal modulation and in the spatial decay of activity correlations?

same_cell_table: molecular class or measured EASI-FISH genes
pairwise: cell-aligned activity traces or a prespecified correlation matrix

semantic_binding_required.arousal_endpoint: must be explicitly defined from the paper/experiment (e.g. pupil/running-linked modulation); generic numeric columns are not auto-promoted
semantic_binding_required.class_column: must be measured/predeclared molecular interneuron class; match-quality labels are forbidden
semantic_binding_required.traces: must correspond one-to-one to matched cell_id values

GAP_execution: Fig1 held-animal genes/type/space models for arousal modulation
relation-index / delta-AIC / effect-size when their inputs are valid
Fig3 fixed-budget measured-panel compression if enough measured genes/animals exist
gap pairwise-correlation for within/across-class correlation-distance curves

paper_native_replication_tests.name: class_dependent_arousal_modulation
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: held-animal class/gene effect on arousal modulation
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: class labels and arousal endpoint must be declared before evaluation

paper_native_replication_tests.name: correlation_distance_falloff
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: one distance-correlation slope/Spearman per animal, separately within/across class
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: cell pairs are descriptive observations, never independent inferential replicates

paper_native_replication_tests.name: within_vs_across_class_geometry
paper_native_replication_tests.primary: compare spatial falloff structure within and across molecular classes
paper_native_replication_tests.guardrail: same cells/coordinates and prespecified distance handling

claim_levels.DIRECT_REPRODUCTION: computed from authors' released biological/method data with matching metric definition
claim_levels.REFERENCE_HEADROOM: self-consistency or hidden-gene recovery inside an external molecular reference; never biological functional replication
claim_levels.ENGINEERING_CONTRACT: synthetic/fixture test showing the route executes and guardrails work
claim_levels.READY_WITH_FULL_DATA: implementation and reference path are ready but required authors' biological data are unavailable
claim_levels.SAFE_STOP: input is incomplete or semantically insufficient; non-applicable analysis is blocked without error

new_data_rule: A future EASI-PASS table is never considered biologically replicated solely because it loads or maps to an atlas. Biological reproduction requires explicit semantic binding of response/arousal endpoints and held-biological-unit inference.
